summary: Retrieve streaming URL and current track info for a Jamendo radio
description: Returns the streaming URL for a given radio (by id or name), along with the currently playing track information and timing details. Note: the stream link returned is currently not working and may never be fixed. Requires a valid client_id and either a radio id or name.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps the JSON response in a callback function for JSONP (only works with json format and GET requests).

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, adds 'results_fullcount' to the header indicating total rows without limit/offset.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A radio id. Either id or name must be provided.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Radio type: 'www' for public radios, 'pro' for commercial radios.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A radio name (unique identifier). Either name or id must be provided.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: The radio image size in pixels.

parameters.name: track_imagesize
parameters.description: The cover size in pixels for tracks.

notes: The stream link returned is currently broken and may never be fixed.
Either 'id' or 'name' must be supplied; both together are not required.
Performance impact: avoid using 'fullcount' on heavy methods.
